# Iceland Campsites for Campervans

> Sourced, dated facts about Icelandic campsites for campervan and motorhome travellers.

Static English reference site. Every campsite fact links to its source and shows the date it was checked; facts that could not be confirmed are marked Unconfirmed. Confirm seasons and prices with the campsite before travelling.

## Guides

- [Campsites Near Keflavík Airport (KEF) for Your First or Last Night (2026)](https://icelandcampsites.com/guides/campsites-near-keflavik-airport/): Campsites near Keflavík Airport for a campervan's first or last night in Iceland: Sandgerði, Garðskagi, Vogar, Happy Campsite and Reykjavík, with 2026 prices, winter status and facilities. Every fact sourced.
- [Campsites Near Reykjavík for Campervans (2026): City, Hafnarfjörður and Mosfellsdalur](https://icelandcampsites.com/guides/campsites-near-reykjavik/): The campsites in and near Reykjavík for campervans: Reykjavík Eco-Campsite (open all year), Hafnarfjörður and Mosskógar, with 2026 prices, winter status, electricity and toilet disposal. Every fact sourced.
- [Where to Empty a Campervan Toilet in Iceland: Dump Stations by Region (2026)](https://icelandcampsites.com/guides/dump-stations-iceland/): Where to empty a cassette or chemical toilet in Iceland: official disposal points, campsites with a dump station on the South Coast and near Keflavík, and the rules. Every entry sourced and dated.
- [Campsites Open in Winter on Iceland's South Coast (2026–27)](https://icelandcampsites.com/guides/south-coast-winter-campsites/): Which South Coast campsites take campervans in winter 2026–27, from Hveragerði to Höfn: winter status, electricity, dump stations and 2026 prices, each fact sourced and dated.
- [Campsites Open in Winter in Iceland (All Regions, 2026–27)](https://icelandcampsites.com/guides/winter-campsites-iceland/): Which Icelandic campsites take campervans in winter 2026–27, region by region: sourced winter status, electricity, dump stations and prices, plus where the official winter list conflicts with campsites' own seasons.

## Hubs

- [All campsites – filter by winter, electricity & dump station](https://icelandcampsites.com/campsites/): All Iceland campsites on this site. Filter by region, open in winter, electricity, showers, dump station and kitchen.
- [Campsites in Capital area, Iceland](https://icelandcampsites.com/regions/capital-area/): 3 campsite(s). Reykjavík and the surrounding towns (Kópavogur, Hafnarfjörður, Garðabær, Mosfellsbær).
- [Campsites in Reykjanes, Iceland](https://icelandcampsites.com/regions/reykjanes/): 4 campsite(s). The peninsula around Keflavík International Airport, including Grindavík, Sandgerði and Garður.
- [Campsites in North East, Iceland](https://icelandcampsites.com/regions/north-east/): 2 campsite(s). Akureyri, Mývatn, Húsavík, Siglufjörður and the north-east coast.
- [Campsites in East Iceland, Iceland](https://icelandcampsites.com/regions/east/): 1 campsite(s). Egilsstaðir, Seyðisfjörður, the Eastfjords and Djúpivogur.
- [Campsites in South Iceland, Iceland](https://icelandcampsites.com/regions/south/): 13 campsite(s). Hveragerði and Selfoss east along the Ring Road to Vík, Skaftafell and Höfn, plus the Golden Circle.
- [Open in winter – Iceland campsites](https://icelandcampsites.com/themes/open-in-winter/): Campsites whose own published information (or an official listing) says they take campers in winter. Status is shown exactly as sourced; 'call ahead' means the source uses vague wording such as 'depending on weather' or 'upon request'.
- [Dump stations / chemical toilet disposal by region – Iceland campsites](https://icelandcampsites.com/themes/dump-stations/): Campsites where a source confirms a disposal point for chemical (cassette) toilets and/or grey water, grouped by region. Sites where disposal is unconfirmed or absent are not listed here.
